chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Jameel, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the cursing man and the cursing woman, how should they both be dealt with? He (peace be upon him) said: 'The Imam (peace be upon him) would sit with his back towards the Qiblah, so he would place both of them in front of him facing the Qiblah, aligned with him, and he would begin with the man, then the woman, and the woman upon whom stoning is obligated, would be stoned from behind her back, and would not be stoned from her face, because the striking and the stoning do not hit the face; they are struck upon the body, upon all of the parts.'

key_terms.الْمُلَاعَنَةِ: The cursing woman (wife accused by husband)
key_terms.الْمُلَاعِنِ: The cursing man (husband who accuses wife of adultery without witnesses)

ai.seo_question: What is the ritual procedure for the cursing (Khassafayn) procedure in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the procedural mechanics of *Li'an* (cursing), where the Imam presides with his back to the Qibla while the husband and wife face it, ensuring the ritual's solemnity and distinctness from prayer. It further clarifies the physical application of punishment, noting that stoning (*Rajm*) and flogging are directed at the body rather than the face, a nuance significant in Shia fiqh for preserving dignity during corporal punishment.

en.hubeali: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Jameel, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,

‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws about a cursing man and a cursing woman how should they both be dealt with?’ Heasws said: ‘The Imamasws would sit with hisasws back towards the Qiblah, so heasws would be pausing both of them in front of himasws facing the Qiblah with hisasws shoes (towards them), and heasws would begin with the man, then the woman, and the one woman upon whom the stoning is Obligated, would be stoned from behind her back, and would not be stoned from her face, because the striking, and the stoning cannot be hitting the face, but both can be stoned upon the body, upon all of the parts’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu Nasr from Jamil from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following:

“I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man and woman who are involved in al-Li‘an (condemnation) and about how they do it. He (the Imam) said, ‘The Imam sits with his back to al-Qiblah (al-Ka‘bah) and they stand in front of him facing al-Qiblah (al-Ka‘bah) before him and he begins with the man, then the woman. The woman on whom stoning is obligatory, is stoned from her backside and not from her front side; beating and stoning must not affect the face. Other parts of the body can be targeted in both, beating and stoning.’” [Note: Such cases are only applicable after due Islamic judicial process]
